text.tspan: Updated for FM5324GA / IP5306-clone charger and boost module
Protected cell • final size not yet selected
USB-C charger + 5 V boost • module is the only charger
Measures cell voltage, not the 5 V rail
BAT− and OUT− are the same internal node
1. Leave XIAO BAT+ and BAT− completely unconnected. The charger/boost module is the only charger.
2. The charger module USB-C is the normal charging port. XIAO USB-C is used for flashing/testing.
3. Never connect XIAO USB-C while the power switch is ON. Use only one USB-C at a time.
4. OUT+ goes through the switch to XIAO 5V and MAX98357A VIN. OUT− is system GND.
5. Battery sensingen tas fra selve cellen (BAT+/BAT−), ikke fra 5 V-utgangen.
6. 10440/≈350 mAh is still under review: measure actual charge current before using the cell.
7. Keep the SD-card slot empty. Leave TFT BLK open; use 3V3 only if the backlight stays off.
Crossings without a junction dot are 90° crossings only and are not electrically connected.
